sources.role: 固定HTML。本文の根拠。blob SHAを実ファイルから計算して指定値と一致確認。

person_reference.reason: 固定本文には確定した当日成績や主役選手の掲載がないため、人物・顔・手を描かずボールとコートの概念イラストとした。HTMLタイトルのベスト5は本文に選出内容がないため見出しに採用しなかった。

brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one Japanese basketball news website thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or 1792x1008 pixels, PNG.
Primary request: Create ONE finished editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ, for the frozen article dated 2026-10-30. The fixed source contains upcoming games only; all same-day player rankings are waiting for official game records. Communicate schedule and pending results, never imply completed scores or selected winners.
Style/medium: expressive hand-drawn ink and dry-brush sports illustration, heavy Japanese gothic display lettering, excellent mobile thumbnail readability. Follow the viewed approved black/lime reference in palette, type weight and brush energy ONLY. Do not copy its person, name, scores, date, pose or other facts.
Scene/backdrop: matte near-black #151A18, restrained large diagonal lime #CCF43B brush swash on right, sparse ink flecks. One vivid orange basketball in the right third, completely visible with comfortable margin. Simple chalk-like court arcs below it. NO people, faces, hands, player silhouettes, jerseys, club logos, sponsor names, scoreboards, medals or trophies. This is a conceptual ball/court illustration, not a real match scene. No photorealism.
Composition: left 60% is clean typographic space; right 40% is the basketball/court art. Headline enormous, bold, cream-white and lime. Small site name top left. Clear open spacing, safe margins at least 60px; all text fully within frame. A quiet small footer zone under the main composition.
Text (verbatim, ONLY these strings; no extra words):
Top-left small: "バスケまとめ"
Main headline line 1, huge lime: "10/30"
Main headline line 2, huge warm-white: "試合予定"
Below headline, clear medium size, two lines:
"当日TOP3は全試合の"
"公式記録確定後に掲載"
Smaller timing note: "2026.10.30 00:59 JST時点"
Footer, two clearly legible small labels: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Constraints: Reproduce every Japanese character and number exactly. Keep the pending-official-record qualifier prominent enough to read. No result numbers, named people, winner claims, best-five selections, invented game actions, or copied reference facts. The footer is a standardized illustration disclosure, not a depiction of an actual performance. No borders, mockup device, extra image panels or watermark.

generator.style_reference_usage: view_imageで確認した承認済みの黒×ライム、太字、手描きブラシの作風のみ参照。選手名・人物・成績は転用していない。
generator.visual_review: 生成画像を実際に目視。全テキストと日付・時刻が意図どおりで、公式記録確定後の掲載という留保が読める。人物・手・チームロゴなし。ボールと文字の見切れなし。イラスト（AI生成）および成績をもとにしたイメージの表記を確認。数値の成績や特定試合場面は描いていない。
